ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure has three inputs A, B, C. B and C are connected to the lower AND-gate symbol, and the output terminal of this lower gate has a small circle, indicating inversion, so the lower output is \overline{BC}. This lower output signal is then connected to one input terminal of the upper gate; A is directly connected to the other input terminal of the upper gate. The upper gate is also an AND-gate symbol, and its output terminal likewise has a small circle, indicating that the final output is inverted. Reasoning: The input product of the upper gate before inversion is A \cdot \overline{BC}, so F = \overline{A \cdot \overline{BC}}. By De Morgan's law, F = \overline{A} + BC.
